description: Generic delivery DAG: research -> design -> implement -> audit/script -> docs -> integrate -> human gate.

tasks.title: Clarify scope and constraints
tasks.brief: Turn the request into a concise scope, explicit non-goals, constraints, and acceptance criteria. Separate facts from assumptions.

tasks.title: Produce the implementation design
tasks.brief: Design a small, testable implementation. Include interfaces, failure modes, and why the design is the simplest option that meets the acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Implement the deliverable
tasks.brief: Implement the design. Provide a runnable code artifact and a short evidence section describing what was actually executed versus what was not.

tasks.title: Independent review
tasks.brief: Review the implementation against the brief and design. Return a JSON verdict with score, pass, issues, and residual risks. Do not rewrite the implementation.

tasks.title: Run deterministic workspace check
tasks.brief: Execute the deterministic check and record the result. This node does not use a model.

tasks.title: Write operator documentation
tasks.brief: Document usage, limitations, and the exact commands a human should run. Do not claim verification that did not happen.

tasks.title: Integrate and state residual risk
tasks.brief: Combine the accepted outputs into one integration note. List what passed, what is still unverified, and the exact next actions. Do not hide gaps.

tasks.title: Human acceptance gate
tasks.brief: A human must review the integration note and decide whether the delivery is accepted. The orchestrator must not self-approve this node.
